name: qualification-10k-8192
description: Exploratory 10K multiwindow cell with an 8192-token output ceiling. The 2048-token pilot censored 7 of 20 responses; a separate 8192-token pilot completed 20 of 20 naturally with lengths of 282-3563 tokens. 8192 is a declared probe value, not a provider-verified output limit, and this profile is outside the 1.1 contract's 1024-token scope. It is exploratory evidence for a future contract revision, not a qualification cell.

qualification.note: Outside the contract's 1024-token scope. This cell cannot qualify an endpoint and its evidence is excluded from the contract's evaluation sample.
